name.ja: <ruby>災禍の根絶者<rt>ヘレティック・エラディケイター</rt></ruby>

text.en: When your opponent would Special Summon exactly 1 monster, while this card is in your hand and your opponent has 4 or more monsters that cannot be Normal Summoned/Set in their face-up field, GY, and/or banishment (Quick Effect): You can negate the Summon, and if you do, destroy that monster, and if you do that, Special Summon this card (while you control no monsters, this effect and its activation cannot be negated). You can send this card from the field to the GY; halve the ATK of 1 monster on the field. You can only use each effect of "Heretic Eradicator" once per turn.
text.zh-CN: 此卡名的①②效果1回合仅可各使用1次。①：此卡存在于手牌，且对手场上（表侧表示）・墓地・除外状态存在4只以上不可通常召唤的怪兽的情况下，对手将仅1只怪兽特殊召唤之际可以发动（自己场上不存在怪兽的情况下，此发动和此效果不会被无效化）。将该特殊召唤无效，将该怪兽破坏，将此卡特殊召唤。②：将场上的此卡送至墓地可以发动。将场上的1只怪兽的攻击力改成一半。
